meta.title: Pokédex
meta.description: Every species in both builds — stats, types, evolutions, learnsets, dex-variant membership and Pokédex text — with the Vanilla build's differing values alongside the Expansion defaults.

prose.heading: The dex
prose.text: This file holds 1025 species records — one per numbered species in the Expansion national dex (#1–#1025): 386 exist in both builds and 639 are Expansion-only. The Expansion species tables hold 1505 [SPECIES_X] initializers, but the 540 dex-less forms are not records — they appear in their base's forms list — and the 60 form groups without an initializer of their own (Castform, Deoxys, Arceus, …) get their base record synthesized from the group's first form. The 25 legacy Unown letters that Vanilla keeps as base-stats-only species — named "?", with no Pokédex entry and no membership in any of its dex variants — are not records. The in-game Pokédex offers 7 dex variants under Vanilla and 37 under Expansion: the same 13 dex families (Rogue, Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar, Paldea, National, Extras and Legends), with several families split per generation under Expansion (e.g. "Kanto (Red/Blue/Yellow)" vs "Kanto (Let'sGo)"). A record's dexVariants field is "all" when the species is listed in every variant of that build, otherwise the display names of the variants that list it. Variant membership is the game's own rule: a species counts when the variant lists the species itself or its base form (RoguePokedex_IsSpeciesAllowed / RoguePokedex_IsBaseSpeciesEnabled), so a family's forms ride along with their base.

prose.heading: Reading an entry
prose.text: Top-level fields carry the Expansion (EX) values: the EX name, national dex number (dexNum) and home region (derived from it), types, base stats, abilities, catch rate, gender ratio, egg groups, base EXP, Pokédex text and category. Where the Vanilla build differs, the record carries a vanilla object holding only those differing fields — for example a different stat line, an extra third ability, a different Pokédex blurb, or a different dex-variant list — and an absent field means the two builds agree (a field with no Vanilla counterpart — the EX-only forms list — is mirrored as an empty value in the overlay so a per-version reader never falls through to the Expansion one). Height and weight are already formatted for display (decimeters and hectograms divided by 10). A description is null when the build has no Pokédex text for the species (one case: the Expansion-only Minior — the game repo carries no Minior Pokédex entry at all, so its description is null). Evolutions are humanized from the EVO_* tables; evo.next is a species' first evolution and evo.prev is its lowest-dex-number source when several species evolve into it. The Expansion species entries may share family stat blocks (X_MISC_INFO macros) — the values shown are each entry's final, per-species numbers after those macros are applied.

prose.heading: Moves
prose.text: moves comes from each species' per-species learnset profile (src/data/rogue/pokemon/{vanilla,expansion}/<id>/), the JSON the game bakes into the Pokédex: levelUp is the [move, level] list (level 0 marks moves learned on evolving), tutor the list of tutor-movable moves, and tm the TMs the species can learn — a TM is learnable only when its sTMHMMoves move appears in the species' level-up or tutor list (CanSpeciesLearnTM), so tm is the intersection of that list with the build's TM table (50 TMs under both builds). Forms are not separate records: the game resolves a species to its base form (GET_BASE_SPECIES_ID) before reading the profile, so the record's learnset is the base species' profile and the forms field merely names the base's forms. Learnsets here are the base profile, not the trainer-revised one.

prose.heading: Sprites
prose.text: Species art is committed under site/assets/pokemon/ as 128×128 RGBA PNGs (see the sprite extractor for how they are produced from each build's front art); a record's art is <id>.png. spriteEx marks the records whose Expansion composite differs from the Vanilla one — 385 species ship both <id>.png and <id>-ex.png, and the -ex file should be used when rendering under Expansion.

While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell
envelops the body to protect it from
enemies.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

vanilla.description:
JIRACHI is said to make wishes come true.
While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell
envelops the body to protect it from
enemies.

records.name: Deoxys
records.description:
Deoxys emerged from a virus that came
from space. It is highly intelligent and
can shoot lasers from the crystalline
organ on its chest.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

vanilla.description:
A POKéMON that mutated from an
extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser
beam. Its body is configured for superior
agility and speed.

records.name: Turtwig
records.description:
The shell on its back is made of soil. 
On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell 
should feel moist. The leaf on its head
wilts if it is thirsty.

records.name: Grotle
records.description:
A Grotle that lives in the forest is said
to have its own secret springwater well. 
It carries fellow Pokémon there on 
its back.

records.name: Torterra
records.description:
Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra's
back and spend their entire life there.
Ancient people imagined that beneath 
the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

records.name: Chimchar
records.description:
Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made
in its belly. Before going to sleep,
Chimchar extinguish the flame on their
tails to prevent fires.

records.name: Monferno
records.description:
It carefully controls the intensity of
the flame on its tail, so as to keep its
foes at an adequate distance.
Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

records.name: Infernape
records.description:
Its crown of fire is indicative of its
fiery nature. It uses a special kind of
martial arts involving all of its limbs to
take on any opponent.

records.name: Piplup
records.description:
A poor walker, it often falls down. However,
its strong pride makes it puff up its chest
without a care. It's difficult to bond with
since it won't listen to its Trainer.

records.name: Prinplup
records.description:
Because every Prinplup considers itself
to be the most important, they can never
form a group. It searches for prey in
icy seas.

records.name: Empoleon
records.description:
The three horns that extend from its beak
attest to its power. It avoids unnecessary
disputes, but it will decimate anything
that threatens its pride.

records.name: Starly
records.description:
They flock around mountains and fields,
chasing after bug Pokémon. However,
they bicker if the group grows too big.
Their singing is noisy and annoying.

records.name: Staravia
records.description:
Recognizing their own weakness, they
maintain huge flocks. Fierce scuffles
break out between various flocks.
When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

records.name: Staraptor
records.description:
When Staravia evolve into Staraptor,
they leave the flock to live alone. It has
a savage nature. It will courageously
challenge foes that are much larger.

records.name: Bidoof
records.description:
A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front
teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's.
It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to
whittle down its front teeth.

records.name: Bibarel
records.description:
It makes its nest by damming streams
with bark and mud. A river dammed by
Bibarel will never overflow its banks,
which is appreciated by people nearby.

records.name: Kricketot
records.description:
It shakes its head back to front,
causing its antennae to hit each other
and sound like a xylophone.
These sounds are fall hallmarks.

records.name: Kricketune
records.description:
It signals its emotions with its melodies.
There is a village that hosts a contest
based on the amazingly variable cries
of this Pokémon.

records.name: Shinx
records.description:
It rapidly contracts and relaxes its
muscles to generate electricity. Its
body shines if endangered. It flees
while the foe is momentarily blinded.

records.name: Luxio
records.description:
Strong electricity courses through the
tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch
has enough amperage to cause fainting
in foes.

records.name: Luxray
records.description:
It has eyes which can see through
anything. Luxray's ability to see
through objects comes in handy when
it's scouting for danger.

records.name: Budew
records.description:
Over the winter, it closes its bud and
endures the cold. Sensitive to changing
temperature, the bud is said to bloom
when it feels the sun's warm touch.

records.name: Roserade
records.description:
Its sweet aroma attracts prey.
With the movements of a dancer,
it strikes with whips that are densely
lined with poison thorns.

records.name: Cranidos
records.description:
A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million
years ago, its skull is as hard as iron. 
It would snap obstructing trees with
headbutts.

records.name: Rampardos
records.description:
The result of repeated headbutts
is a skull grown thick and hard.
However, its brain has shrunk in size
compared with Cranidos's.

records.name: Shieldon
records.description:
This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles.
Few enemies would have been willing to
square off against its heavily armored
face, so it's thought.

records.name: Bastiodon
records.description:
Their rock-hard faces serve to protect
them from any frontral attacks.
When attacked, they form a wall.
They shielded their young in that way.

records.name: Burmy
records.description:
If its cloak is even slightly damaged, it
will immediately repair it with whatever is
near at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak
is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.

records.name: Wormadam
records.description:
Its appearance changes depending
on where Burmy evolved. The materials
on hand become a part of its body.
The cloak is never shed.

records.name: Mothim
records.description:
It does not keep a nest. While it
loves floral honey, it won't gather
any itself. Instead, it plots to steal
honey collected by Combee.

records.name: Combee
records.description:
A Pokémon formed by three others.
It constantly gathers honey from flowers
to please Vespiquen. At night, they
cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

records.name: Vespiquen
records.description:
It houses its colony in cells in its body
and releases various pheromones to
make those grubs do its bidding.
There is only one in a colony.

records.name: Pachirisu
records.description:
A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek
pouches together in an effort to share
stored electricity. It stores them with
berries in tree holes.

records.name: Buizel
records.description:
It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its
face above water in order to watch for
prey movement. It swims by rotating its
two tails like a screw.

records.name: Floatzel
records.description:
Its flotation sac developed as a result
of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double
as a rubber raft. It assists in the rescues
of drowning people.

records.name: Cherubi
records.description:
The small ball holds the nutrients needed
for evolution. Apparently, it is also very
sweet and tasty. Pokémon like Starly and
Taillow try to peck it off.

records.name: Cherrim
records.description:
It's motionless, save for the occasional
quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be
found gathered around it, drawn by the
scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.

records.name: Shellos
records.description:
It oozes a purple fluid to deter enemies.
While harmless, the fluid is awfully sticky.
Apparently, there are more West Sea
Shellos now than there were in the past.

records.name: Gastrodon
records.description:
It appears on shallow-water beaches to
eat sand for nourishment. Should one
Gastrodon encounter another of a
different color, a fierce battle will ensue.

records.name: Ambipom
records.description:
They live on large trees. Split into two,
the tails are so adept at handling and
doing things, Ambipom rarely uses
its hands now.

records.name: Drifloon
records.description:
Because of the way it floats aimlessly,
an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for
Wandering Spirits.” Children holding
them sometimes vanish.

records.name: Drifblim
records.description:
Even while under careful observation,
large flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk
will inexplicably disappear from view.
No one knows where they go.

records.name: Buneary
records.description:
You can tell how it feels by the way
it rolls its ears. When it's scared,
both ears are rolled up. When it senses
danger, it perks them up.

records.name: Lopunny
records.description:
An extremely cautious Pokémon.
It is very conscious of its looks and
never fails to groom its ears.
It runs with sprightly jumps.

records.name: Mismagius
records.description:
Its cries sound like incantations.
Those hearing it are tormented by
headaches and hallucinations.
It appears where you least expect it.

records.name: Honchkrow
records.description:
Becoming active at night, it is known
to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow.
It is said that it never forgives the
mistakes of its cronies.

records.name: Glameow
records.description:
It is a very fickle Pokémon, which is 
very popular among some. It claws its
Trainer's nose if it isn't fed and
purrs when affectionate.

records.name: Purugly
records.description:
It is a brazen brute that barges its way
into another Pokémon's nest and claims
it as its own. It binds its body with its
tails to make itself look bigger.

records.name: Chingling
records.description:
There is an orb inside its mouth.
When it hops, the orb bounces all
over and makes a ringing sound.
It can cry for an awfully long time.

records.name: Stunky
records.description:
It protects itself by spraying a
nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear
to repel attackers. The stench lingers
for 24 hours.

records.name: Skuntank
records.description:
It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly
fluid from the tip of its tail. The fluid
smells worse the longer it is allowed
to fester.

records.name: Bronzor
records.description:
Implements shaped like it were discovered
in ancient tombs. There are researchers
who believe this Pokémon reflected like a
mirror in the distant past.

records.name: Bronzong
records.description:
In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as
a bringer of rain. One caused a news stir
when it was dug up at a construction site
after a 2000-year sleep.

records.name: Bonsly
records.description:
Bonsly prefers an arid atmosphere.
In order to adjust the level of fluids
in its body, it exudes water from its eyes.
This makes it appear to be crying.

records.name: Mime Jr.
records.description:
In an attempt to confuse its enemy,
it mimics the enemy's movements.
Once mimicked, the foe cannot take
its eyes off this Pokémon.

records.name: Happiny
records.description:
It carries a round white rock in its
belly pouch. If it gets along well with
someone, it will sometimes give that
person the rock.

next.method: Level up while holding Oval Stone (daytime)

records.name: Chatot
records.description:
It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to
trick them into thinking it's one of them.
This way they won't attack it. It can
also learn and speak human words.

records.name: Spiritomb
records.description:
A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits.
Its constant mischief and misdeeds
resulted in it being bound to an
Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

records.name: Gible
records.description:
It nests in horizontal holes warmed by
geothermal heat. Foes who stray too
close can expect to be pounced on
and bitten.

records.name: Gabite
records.description:
Shiny objects are its passion. It can be
found in its cave, scarcely moving,
its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed
or Carbink it has caught.

records.name: Garchomp
records.description:
When it folds up its body and extends its
wings, it looks like a jet plane. It is
covered in fine scales that reduce drag,
enabling it to fly at high speeds.

records.name: Munchlax
records.description:
When it finds something that looks like
it might be edible, it goes right ahead
and swallows it whole. That's why it gets
fatter day by day.

records.name: Riolu
records.description:
It can discern the physical and emotional
states of people, Pokémon, and other
natural things from the shape of their
aura waves.

records.name: Lucario
records.description:
It understands human speech.
It is said that no foe can remain invisible
to Lucario, since it can detect Auras.
Even foes it could not otherwise see.

records.name: Hippopotas
records.description:
Hippopotas shuts its nostrils tight when
travelling through sand. Instead of
perspiration, it expels grains of sand
from its body.

records.name: Hippowdon
records.description:
It is surprisingly quick to anger.
It brandishes its gaping mouth in a
display of fearsome strength and raises
vast quantities of sand while attacking.

records.name: Skorupi
records.description:
It grips prey with its tail claws and
injects poison. It tenaciously hangs
on until the poison takes.
It can survive a year without food.

records.name: Drapion
records.description:
Possessing a sturdy build, it takes
pride in its strength. It has the power
in its clawed arms to make scrap
out of a car.

records.name: Croagunk
records.description:
Croagunk rarely fights fairly. Inflating
its poison sacs, it fills the area with
an odd sound and hits flinching
opponents with a poison jab.

records.name: Toxicroak
records.description:
Swaying and dodging the attacks
of its foes, it weaves its flexible body
in close, then lunges out with its
poisonous claws.

records.name: Carnivine
records.description:
Hanging from branches using its
tentacles, it looks like a plant.
It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling
saliva, then chomps down.

records.name: Finneon
records.description:
Its double tail fins propel its energetic
jumps. When it breaks the surface of the
sea, Wingull swoop down to grab it on
the fly.

records.name: Lumineon
records.description:
Lumineon swimming in the darkness
of the deep sea look like stars shining
in the night sky. It competes for food
with Lanturn.

records.name: Mantyke
records.description:
When it swims close to the surface
of the ocean, people aboard ships are
able to observe the pattern on its back.
It often swims in a school of Remoraid.

next.method: Level up with Remoraid in party

records.name: Snover
records.description:
During cold seasons, it migrates to the
mountain's lower reaches. Seemingly
curious about people, they gather around
footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

records.name: Abomasnow
records.description:
It lives a quiet life on mountains that
are perpetually covered in snow. It hides
itself by whipping up blizzards.
It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”

records.name: Weavile
records.description:
They travel in groups of four or five,
leaving signs for one another on trees
and rocks. They bring down their prey
with coordinated attacks.

prev.method: Level up while holding Razor Claw (night)

records.name: Magnezone
records.description:
As it zooms through the sky, this
Pokémon seems to be receiving signals
of unknown origin, while transmitting its
own signals of unknown purpose.

records.name: Lickilicky
records.description:
The long tongue is always soggy with
slobber. The saliva contains a solvent
that causes numbness. Getting too close
to it will leave you soaked with drool.

records.name: Rhyperior
records.description:
It can launch a rock held in its hand
like a missile by tightening and then
expanding its muscles instantaneously.
Geodude are shot at rare times.

records.name: Tangrowth
records.description:
It ensnares prey by extending arms made
of vines. Even if one of its arms is eaten,
it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly
and will go right back to normal.

records.name: Electivire
records.description:
When it gets excited, it thumps its chest.
With every thud, thunder roars, electric
sparks shower all around and blue sparks
begin to crackle between its horns.

records.name: Magmortar
records.description:
According to what is known, a single pair
of male and female Magmortar lives in
one volcano. From its arm, it launches
fireballs hotter than 3,600ºF.

records.name: Togekiss
records.description:
As everyone knows, it visits peaceful
regions, bringing them gifts of kindness
and sweet blessings. It will never appear
where there is strife.

records.name: Yanmega
records.description:
This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable
of transporting an adult in flight. It is
adept at biting apart foes while flying
by at high speed.

records.name: Leafeon
records.description:
Its cellular composition is closer to
that of a plant than an animal. It uses
photosynthesis to produce its energy
supply without eating food.

records.name: Glaceon
records.description:
It can control its body temperature
at will. This enables it to freeze the
moisture in the atmosphere, creating
flurries of diamond dust.

records.name: Gliscor
records.description:
Gliscor observes prey while hanging
upside down from branches. Its flight is
soundless. When the chance presents
itself, it swoops!

prev.method: Level up while holding Razor Fang (night)

records.name: Mamoswine
records.description:
A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice
dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to
much amazement. This Pokémon has been
around for a long, long, long time.

records.name: Porygon-Z
records.description:
In order to create a more advanced
Pokémon, an additional program was
installed, but apparently it contained a
defect that made it move oddly.

records.name: Gallade
records.description:
A master of courtesy and swordsmanship,
it fights using extending swords on its
elbows when trying to protect someone.
It can sense what its foe is thinking.

records.name: Probopass
records.description:
It freely controls three units called
Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
With them, it can attack its foes from
three directions.

records.name: Dusknoir
records.description:
This feared Pokémon is said to travel to
worlds unknown. Some even believe that
it takes lost spirits into its pliant body
and guides them home.

records.name: Froslass
records.description:
When it finds people or Pokémon it likes,
it freezes them and takes them to its
chilly den, where they become its
decorations.

records.name: Rotom
records.description:
Its body is composed of plasma and loves
to surprise others. One boy's invention led
to the development of many machines that
can use of Rotom's unique capabilities.

records.name: Uxie
records.description:
Known as ”The Being of Knowledge,”
according to some sources, this Pokémon
provided people with the intelligence
necessary to solve various problems.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Mesprit
records.description:
Although it slumbers at the bottom of a
lake, its spirit is said to leave its body
and flitter on the water surface. It
taught humans of sorrow, pain, and joy.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Azelf
records.description:
This Pokémon is said to have endowed
humans with the determination needed to
do things. It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit
and Azelf all came from the same egg.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Dialga
records.description:
A Pokémon spoken of in legend.
It completely controls the flow of time.
It uses its power to travel at will
through the past and future.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Palkia
records.description:
Palkia has the ability to distort space.
Its total control over the boundaries of
space enable it to transport itself to
faraway places and other dimensions.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Heatran
records.description:
Boiling blood, like magma, circulates
through its body. It dwells in volcanic
caves, using its cross-shaped feet
to crawl on ceilings and walls.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Regigigas
records.description:
There is an enduring legend that
states this Pokémon shaped Regirock,
Regice, and Registeel out of clay, ice,
and magma.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Giratina
records.description:
This Pokémon is said to live in a world
on the reverse side of ours, where common
knowledge is distorted and strange.
It was banished for its violence.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Cresselia
records.description:
Those who sleep holding one of
Cresselia's feathers are assured of
joyful dreams. It is said to represent
the crescent moon.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Phione
records.description:
When the water warms, they inflate the
flotation sac on their heads and drift
languidly on the sea in packs.
It always returns to where it was born.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Manaphy
records.description:
Water makes up 80% of its body.
It starts its life with a wondrous power
that permits it to bond with any kind
of Pokémon.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Darkrai
records.description:
It chases people and Pokémon from its
territory by causing them to experience
deep, nightmarish slumbers. However,
it means no harm.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_4.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/darkrai/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/darkrai/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Shaymin
records.description:
The flowers all over its body bloom if it is
lovingly hugged and senses gratitude. It
dissolves toxins in the air to transform
ruined land into a lush field of flowers.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_4.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/shaymin/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/shaymin/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Arceus
records.description:
It is told in mythology that this Pokémon
emerged from an egg and shaped all there
is in this world, before the universe
even existed.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_4.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/species_info.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/arceus/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/arceus/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Victini
records.description:
This Pokémon brings victory.
It is said that Trainers with Victini
always win, regardless of the type
of encounter.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Snivy
records.description:
It is very intelligent and calm.
Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes
its movements swifter. When they are
not feeling well, their tails droop.

records.name: Servine
records.description:
When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be
used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps
clean. They avoid attacks by sinking into
the shadows of thick foliage.

records.name: Serperior
records.description:
They raise their heads to intimidate foes,
but only give it their all when fighting
powerful opponents who are not fazed
by the glare from its noble eyes.

records.name: Tepig
records.description:
It loves to eat roasted berries, but
sometimes it gets too excited and burns
them to a crisp. It blows fire through
its nose.

records.name: Pignite
records.description:
The more it eats, the more fuel it has
to make the fire in its stomach stronger.
When it is angered, the intensity of the
flame increases.

records.name: Emboar
records.description:
It is adept at using many different moves.
It can throw a fire punch by setting its
fists on fire with its fiery chin.
It cares deeply about its friends.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/emboar/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/emboar/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Oshawott
records.description:
The scalchop on its stomach isn't just
used for battle, it can be used to break
open hard berries as well. It is made
from the same element as its claws.

records.name: Dewott
records.description:
Strict training and disclipine leads it
to master its flowing double-scalchop
technique. Scalchop techniques differ
from one Dewott to another.

records.name: Samurott
records.description:
One swing of the seamitars attached
to its armor can fell an opponent.
A simple glare from one of them is
enough to intimidate most enemies.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/samurott/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/samurott/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Patrat
records.description:
Extremely cautious, they take shifts to
maintain a constant watch of their nest.
Using food stored in cheek pouches,
they can keep watch for days.

records.name: Watchog
records.description:
Using luminescent matter, it makes its
eyes and body glow and stuns attacking
opponents. Keen eyesight lets them see
in the dark.

records.name: Lillipup
records.description:
It faces strong opponents with great
courage. Because it doesn't yelp, it's
extremely popular with Trainers who live
in apartment buildings.

records.name: Herdier
records.description:
Its dense black fur grows continuously.
The high cost of keeping its hard fur
properly groomed makes this a
troublesome Pokémon to train.

records.name: Stoutland
records.description:
Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant,
there could be no concern that it would
ever attack people. Some parents even
trust it to babysit.

records.name: Purrloin
records.description:
Their deceptively cute act is the
perfect ruse. They steal from people for
fun, but their victims can't help but
forgive them.

records.name: Liepard
records.description:
Many Trainers are drawn to their
beautiful form and fur. These Pokémon
vanish and appear unexpectedly.
They run silently in the night.

records.name: Pansage
records.description:
This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest.
It's good at finding berries and gathers
them from all over. It's kind enough to
share them with friends.

records.name: Simisage
records.description:
Ill tempered, it attacks enemies by
swinging its barbed tail around wildly.
The leaf growing on its head is
very bitter.

records.name: Pansear
records.description:
The fire within the tuft on its head can
reach up to 600ºF. Very intelligent,
it roasts berries before eating them.
It likes to help people.

records.name: Simisear
records.description:
It loves sweets because they become
energy for the fire burning inside its
body. It scatters embers from its head
and tail to sear its opponents.

records.name: Panpour
records.description:
The water stored inside the tuft of its
head is rich in nutrients. It waters
plants using its tail, plants that
receive its water grow large.

records.name: Simipour
records.description:
It can shoot highly-pressurised water
from its tail with enough power to
break through a solid concrete wall.
It prefers places with clean water.

records.name: Munna
records.description:
This Pokémon appears before people
and Pokémon who are having nightmares
and eats those dreams. Munna always
float in the air.

records.name: Musharna
records.description:
The mist emanating from their foreheads
is packed with the dreams of people and
Pokémon. It changes into different colors
depending on the dream that was eaten.

records.name: Pidove
records.description:
This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for
a new order from its Trainer even though
it already has one. Flocks often gather
in parks and plazas.

records.name: Tranquill
records.description:
No matter where in the world it goes,
it knows where its nest is, so it can
always return to its Trainer's location
regardless of the distance.

records.name: Unfezant
records.description:
Males have plumage on their heads.
The females' flying abilities surpass
those of the males. They will only let
themselves feel close to their Trainers.

records.name: Blitzle
records.description:
Its mane shines when it discharges
electricity. They use the frequency and
rhythm of these flashes to communicate
with one another.

records.name: Zebstrika
records.description:
When Zebstrika run at full speed, the
sound of thunder reverberates. It is
dangerous when it's angry as it shoots
lightning from its mane in all directions.

records.name: Roggenrola
records.description:
The hexagonal cavity is its ear.
It walks in the direction of sounds it
hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics
and topples over.

records.name: Boldore
records.description:
Its orange crystal is a mass of energy.
Just one crystal fragment would provide
enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks.
When it is healthy, its core sticks out.

records.name: Gigalith
records.description:
The blasts of energy it makes from
sunbeams have terrifying power.
However, it's not able to fire its blasts
at night or on rainy days.

records.name: Woobat
records.description:
Its habitat is dark forests and caves.
Suction from its nostrils enables it
to stick to cave walls during sleep.
It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

records.name: Swoobat
records.description:
Anyone who comes into contact with
the ultrasonic waves emitted by a
courting male experiences a positive
mood shift.

records.name: Drilbur
records.description:
It can dig through the ground at a
speed of 30 mph by spinning its body.
It could give a car running aboveground
a good race.

records.name: Excadrill
records.description:
More than 300 feet below the surface,
they build mazelike nests. Their activity
can be destructive to subway tunnels,
but it can also help with construction.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/excadrill/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/excadrill/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Audino
records.description:
Its auditory sense is astounding.
Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell
how someone is feeling or when an egg
might hatch.

records.name: Timburr
records.description:
These Pokémon appear at building
sites and help out with construction.
They always carry squared logs.
As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

records.name: Gurdurr
records.description:
They strengthen their bodies by carrying
steel beams. This Pokémon is so muscular
and strongly built that even a group of
wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

records.name: Conkeldurr
records.description:
They use concrete pillars as walking
canes. Rather than rely solely on force,
they master moves that utilize the
centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

records.name: Tympole
records.description:
By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound
waves imperceptible to humans. It uses
the rhythm of these sounds to talk and
warns others of danger.

records.name: Palpitoad
records.description:
It lives in the water and on land.
When they vibrate the bumps on their
heads, they can make waves in water
or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

records.name: Seismitoad
records.description:
It increases the power of its punches
by vibrating the bumps on its fists.
They can also shoot paralyzing liquid
from their head bumps.

records.name: Throh
records.description:
When it tightens its belt, it becomes
stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave
their own belts. It changes belts as it
gets more powerful.

records.name: Sawk
records.description:
The sound of Sawk punching boulders
and trees can be heard all the way from
the mountains where they train.
Disturbing their training angers them.

records.name: Sewaddle
records.description:
It chews up leaves and sews them with
sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes,
it is a mascot for fashion designers.

records.name: Swadloon
records.description:
Forests where Swadloon live have
superb foliage because the nutrients
they make from fallen leaves nourish
the plant life.

records.name: Leavanny
records.description:
It keeps its eggs warm with heat from
fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to
weave warm wrappings for Sewaddle by
using the silk secreted from its mouth.

records.name: Venipede
records.description:
Using the feelers on its head and tail,
it picks up vibrations in the air to
determine its prey's location and state.
It is brutally aggressive.

records.name: Whirlipede
records.description:
Storing energy for evolution, it sits.
But when attacked, it spins its body at
high speed like a wheel and then
crashes furiously into its opponent.

records.name: Scolipede
records.description:
With quick movements, it chases down
its foes, attacking relentlessly with its
horns until it prevails. Then it finishes
them off with deadly poison.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/scolipede/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/scolipede/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Cottonee
records.description:
When it finds others of its kind, they all
stick together. When enough of them
have collected, the mass resembles a
cumulonimbus cloud.

records.name: Whimsicott
records.description:
It rides on the wind and slips into
people's homes. After it has turned a
room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles
to itself and takes off.

records.name: Petilil
records.description:
By pruning the leaves on its head with
regularity, this Pokémon can be grown
into a fine plump shape. These bitter
leaves refresh those who eat them.

records.name: Lilligant
records.description:
Even veteran Trainers face a challenge
in getting its beautiful flower to bloom.
It withers away if a trainer does not
take good care of it.

records.name: Basculin
records.description:
It used to be a common food source. The
meat of red Basculin is on the fatty side
and it's more popular with the youth.
Its temperament is vicious and aggressive.

records.name: Sandile
records.description:
It conceals itself in the sand and
chomps down on the legs of any prey
that unwarily walk over it. Its favorite
food is Trapinch.

records.name: Krokorok
records.description:
They move in groups of a few individuals.
Thanks to the special membrane covering
its eyes, it can see its surroundings
clearly, even in the dead of night.

records.name: Krookodile
records.description:
Very violent Pokémon, they never allow
their prey to escape. Their jaws are so
powerful, they can crush the body of
an automobile.

records.name: Darumaka
records.description:
When its internal fire is burning, it
cannot calm down and it runs around.
When the fire diminishes, it pulls its
limbs into its body and falls asleep.

records.name: Darmanitan
records.description:
When one is injured in a fierce battle,
it transforms into a stone statue.
Then it meditates and sharpens its
mind and fights on mentally.

records.name: Maractus
records.description:
Arid regions are their habitat.
When it moves rhythmically, it makes a
sound similar to maracas, making the
surprised Pokémon flee.

records.name: Dwebble
records.description:
It makes a hole in a stone of a suitable
size. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon
remains agitated until it locates
a replacement.

records.name: Crustle
records.description:
Competing for territory, Crustle fight
viciously. The one whose boulder is
broken is the loser of the battle and
begins to weaken.

records.name: Scraggy
records.description:
Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it
can reduce damage by defensively
pulling its skin up to its neck.
Its skull is massively thick.

records.name: Scrafty
records.description:
Groups of them beat up anything that
enters their territory. The one with the
biggest crest is the group leader, and
is the most respected.

records.name: Sigilyph
records.description:
The guardians of an ancient city, they
always fly the same route while keeping
watch for invaders. They use their
psychic power to attack enemies.

records.name: Yamask
records.description:
These Pokémon arose from the spirits
of people interred in graves in past ages.
Each of them carries a mask that used
to be its face when it was human.

records.name: Cofagrigus
records.description:
Grave robbers who mistake them for
real coffins and get too close end up
trapped inside their bodies. Their bodies
are covered in pure gold.

records.name: Tirtouga
records.description:
Reputed to be the ancestor of most
turtle Pokémon, it lived in warm seas
about a hundred million years ago.
It was restored from a fossil.

records.name: Carracosta
records.description:
They can live both in the ocean and
on land. Incredible jaw strength enables
them to chew up steel beams and rocks
along with their prey.

records.name: Archen
records.description:
Said to be the ancestor of all bird
Pokémon, Archen itself could not actually
fly but moved by hopping from treetop
to treetop.

records.name: Archeops
records.description:
They are intelligent and will cooperate
to catch prey. When one Archeops
had the prey cornered, another would
swoop on it.

records.name: Trubbish
records.description:
It gorges on trash until its stomach
is full. Then it belches toxic gas.
An unlucky whiff of this gas will put
a person in the hospital.

records.name: Garbodor
records.description:
Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots
from its right arm. If even a little of it
gets on you, you'll experience the full
effects of this unidentified toxin.

records.name: Zorua
records.description:
To protect themselves from danger, they
hide their true identities by transforming
into people and Pokémon. Apparently, it
often transforms into a silent child.

records.name: Zoroark
records.description:
Bonds between these Pokémon are very
strong. It protects the safety of its
pack by tricking its opponents. They
defend their lair with illusory scenery.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/zoroark/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/zoroark/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Minccino
records.description:
These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat.
They greet one another by rubbing each
other with their tails, which are always
kept well groomed and clean.

records.name: Cinccino
records.description:
Their white fur feels amazing to touch.
Cinccino's body is coated in a special
oil that repels dust and helps it deflect
attacks, such as punches.

records.name: Gothita
records.description:
They intently observe both Trainers and
Pokémon. Apparently, Gothita are looking
at something that only they can see. Their
ribbonlike feelers increase their power.

records.name: Gothorita
records.description:
Starlight is the source of their power.
They use hypnosis to control people and
Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading them
astray are told in every corner.

records.name: Gothitelle
records.description:
Starry skies thousands of light-years
away are visible in the space distorted by
their intense psychic power. When it learns
its Trainer's life span, it cries in sadness.

records.name: Solosis
records.description:
Because their bodies are enveloped
in a special liquid, they are fine in any
environment, no matter how severe. They
can use telepathy to talk with others.

records.name: Duosion
records.description:
When their brains, now divided in two,
are thinking the same thoughts,
these Pokémon exhibit their maximized
psychic power.

records.name: Reuniclus
records.description:
They use psychic power to control their
arms, which are made of a special liquid.
When Reuniclus shake hands, a network
forms between their brains.

records.name: Ducklett
records.description:
These bird Pokémon are excellent divers.
They are better at swimming than flying,
and they happily eat their favorite food,
peat moss, as they dive underwater.

records.name: Swanna
records.description:
Despite their elegant appearance, they
can flap their wings strongly and fly for
thousands of miles. The one in the middle
is the leader of the flock.

records.name: Vanillite
records.description:
The temperature of their breath is -58ºF.
They create snow crystals and make snow
fall in the areas around them. Vanillite is
treasured by households in warm regions.

records.name: Vanillish
records.description:
Vanillish has existed since the Ice Age.
It controls particles of ice, freezes its
opponents, and then shatters them with
a headbutt.

records.name: Vanilluxe
records.description:
Each of its two heads has a brain, and
when they are in agreement, it attacks
its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard.
It makes snow clouds inside its body.

records.name: Deerling
records.description:
Deerling have different scents
depending on the season. In early
spring, these Pokémon give off a
delicate, sweet, and calming scent.

records.name: Sawsbuck
records.description:
Some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers
of spring because the plants growing on
its horns change according to the season.
The leader possesses magnificent horns.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/sawsbuck/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/sawsbuck/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Emolga
records.description:
It glides using its cape-like membrane.
It grills berries and bug Pokémon with
electric shocks from the pouches on its
cheeks and makes a meal of them.

records.name: Karrablast
records.description:
When they feel threatened, they spit an
acidic liquid to drive attackers away.
For some reason they evolve while they
are in the same place as Shelmet.

records.name: Escavalier
records.description:
Wearing the shell covering they stole
from Shelmet, they defend themselves and
attack with two lances. The steel armor
protects their whole body.

records.name: Foongus
records.description:
It lures Pokémon in with its pattern that
looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases
its poison spores. Why it resembles a
Poké Ball is unknown.

records.name: Amoonguss
records.description:
It lures prey close by dancing and waving
its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls,
in a swaying motion, but very few Pokémon
are fooled by this.

records.name: Frillish
records.description:
If its veil-like arms stun and wrap an
opponent, that foe will be dragged
five miles below the surface to its lair,
never to return.

records.name: Jellicent
records.description:
They propel themselves by expelling
absorbed seawater from their bodies.
It's said there's a castle of ships
Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

records.name: Alomomola
records.description:
When they find a wounded Pokémon,
they embrace it and bring it to shore.
The special membrane enveloping
Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

records.name: Joltik
records.description:
Since they can't generate their own
electricity, they attach themselves to
large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static
electricity, which they store in a pouch.

records.name: Galvantula
records.description:
It creates barriers from electrified silk
that stun foes. This works as a weapon as
well as a defense. While it is immobilized
by shock, they leisurely consume it.

records.name: Ferroseed
records.description:
It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock
while clinging to the ceiling of caves.
When threatened, it attacks by shooting
a barrage of spikes.

records.name: Ferrothorn
records.description:
It fights by swinging around its three
spiky feelers and shooting spikes.
A hit from these steel spikes can reduce
a boulder to rubble.

records.name: Klink
records.description:
Two bodies comprise a fixed pair.
The two minigears that mesh together
are predetermined. Each will rebound from
other minigears without meshing.

records.name: Klang
records.description:
A minigear and big gear comprise its
body. Spinning minigears are rotated
at high speed and repeatedly fired away.
It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

records.name: Klinklang
records.description:
Its red core functions as an energy tank.
It is rotated at high speed for a rapid
energy charge. It fires the charged energy
through its spikes into an area.

records.name: Tynamo
records.description:
These Pokémon move in schools.
One alone can emit only a trickle of
electricity, so a group of them gathers
to unleash a powerful electric shock.

records.name: Eelektrik
records.description:
These Pokémon have a big appetite.
It wraps itself around its prey and
paralyzes it with electricity from the
round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

records.name: Eelektross
records.description:
They crawl out of the ocean using their
arms. They will attack prey on shore and
immediately drag it into the ocean, with
their sucker mouths.

records.name: Elgyem
records.description:
It psychically squeezes the brain of
its foe, causing unendurable headaches.
Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO
crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

records.name: Beheeyem
records.description:
It can manipulate an opponent's memory.
Apparently, it communicates by flashing
its three fingers, but those patterns
haven't been decoded.

records.name: Litwick
records.description:
While Litwick shines a light and pretends
to be a guide, it absorbs the life force of
any who follow it, which becomes the fuel
that it burns.

records.name: Lampent
records.description:
This ominous Pokémon is feared.
Through cities it wanders, searching
for the spirits of the fallen. The spirits
it absorbs fuel its baleful fire.

records.name: Chandelure
records.description:
Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns
up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
By waving the flames on its arms, it puts
its foes into a hypnotic trance.

records.name: Axew
records.description:
They mark their territory by leaving
gashes in trees with their tusks. If a
tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly,
harder and sturdier than the last.

records.name: Fraxure
records.description:
Their tusks can shatter rocks.
A broken tusk will not grow back,
so it diligently sharpens its tusks on
river rocks after the end of a battle.

records.name: Haxorus
records.description:
They are kind but can be relentless
when defending territory. Their sturdy
tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut
steel beams.

records.name: Cubchoo
records.description:
Its nose is always running.
Their snot is a barometer of health.
When healthy, their snot is sticky and
the power of their ice moves increases.

records.name: Beartic
records.description:
It freezes its breath to create fangs
and claws of ice to fight with.
Very able in the water, it swims around
in northern seas and catches prey.

records.name: Cryogonal
records.description:
They are born in snow clouds. When
its body temperature goes up, it turns
into steam and vanishes. When its
temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

records.name: Shelmet
records.description:
When attacked, it defends itself by
closing the lid of its shell. It evolves
when bathed in an electric-like energy
along with Karrablast.

records.name: Accelgor
records.description:
When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to
prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in
layers of thin membrane. It is very light
and fights with ninja-like movements.

records.name: Stunfisk
records.description:
It conceals itself in the mud of the
seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch
it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.
It smiles when transmitting electricity.

records.name: Mienfoo
records.description:
They have mastered elegant combos.
As they concentrate, their battle moves
become swifter and more precise. What it
lacks in power, it makes up for in quantity.

records.name: Mienshao
records.description:
They use the long fur on their arms as
a whip to strike their opponents. Its arm
attacks come with such rapidity that they
cannot even be seen.

records.name: Druddigon
records.description:
It warms its body by absorbing sunlight
with its wings. When its body temperature
falls, it can no longer move. It uses its
sharp claws to catch prey.

records.name: Golett
records.description:
These Pokémon are thought to have
been created by the science of an
ancient and mysterious civilization.
It's been active for thousands of years.

records.name: Golurk
records.description:
Golurk were created to protect people
and Pokémon by an ancient civilisation.
Removing the seal on its chest makes its
internal energy go out of control.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/golurk/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/golurk/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Pawniard
records.description:
Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by
sinking the blades that cover their bodies
into their prey. If battling dulls them, it
sharpens them on stones by the river.

records.name: Bisharp
records.description:
This pitiless Pokémon commands a group
of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility.
It battles to become the boss, but will be
driven from the group if it loses.

records.name: Bouffalant
records.description:
Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even
if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
Their headbutts have enough destructive
force to derail a train.

records.name: Rufflet
records.description:
With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces
its prey, and then it pecks at them.
Although it also consumes berries, it's a
carnivore at heart.

records.name: Braviary
records.description:
For the sake of its friends, this brave
warrior of the sky will not stop battling,
even if it is injured. One can carry a car
while flying.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/braviary/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/braviary/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Vullaby
records.description:
It can't fly yet and must wait until its
wings have developed more. They guard
their posteriors with bones that were
gathered by Mandibuzz.

records.name: Mandibuzz
records.description:
They adorn themselves beautifully with
bones. This is supposedly an effort to
attract males, but no male Mandibuzz
have ever been found.

records.name: Heatmor
records.description:
It draws in air through its tail, transforms
it into fire, and uses it like a tongue.
They burn through Durant's steel bodies
and consume their insides.

records.name: Durant
records.description:
Durant dig nests in mountains.
Individuals each play different roles in
driving Heatmor, their natural predator,
away from their colony.

records.name: Deino
records.description:
Lacking sight, it's unaware of its
surroundings, so it bumps into things and
eats anything that moves. Approaching
it carelessly is dangerous.

records.name: Zweilous
records.description:
After it has eaten up all the food in its
territory, it moves on to another area.
Whichever head eats more than the other
gets to be the leader.

records.name: Hydreigon
records.description:
This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on
its six wings. The heads on their arms do
not have brains. They use all three heads
to consume and destroy everything.

records.name: Larvesta
records.description:
This Pokémon was believed to have
been born from the sun. It spews fire from
its horns and encases itself in a cocoon
of fire when it evolves.

records.name: Volcarona
records.description:
When volcanic ash darkened the
atmosphere, it appeared and saved Pokémon
from freezing, Volcarona's fire provided a
replacement for the sun.

records.name: Cobalion
records.description:
It has a body and heart of steel. This
legendary Pokémon battled against humans
to protect Pokémon. Its personality
is calm and composed.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/cobalion/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/cobalion/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Terrakion
records.description:
Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used
its phenomenal power to destroy a castle
in its effort to protect Pokémon that had
lost their homes in a war among humans.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/terrakion/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/terrakion/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Virizion
records.description:
Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades.
Legends say this Pokémon used
whirlwind-like movements to confound
and swiftly cut its opponents.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/virizion/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/virizion/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Tornadus
records.description:
Tornadus expels massive energy from
its tail, causing severe storms.
Its power can blow entire houses away.
It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Thundurus
records.description:
The spikes on its tail discharge immense
bolts of lightning. Countless charred
remains mar the landscape of places
through which Thundurus has passed.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/thundurus/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/thundurus/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Reshiram
records.description:
This Pokémon appears in legends. It
sends flames into the air from its tail,
burning up everything around it. It helps
those who want to build a world of truth.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/reshiram/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/reshiram/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Zekrom
records.description:
This legendary Pokémon can scorch the
world with lightning. It has a generator
that creates electricity in its tail. It
assists those with strong ideals.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/zekrom/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/zekrom/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Landorus
records.description:
The energy that comes pouring from its tail
increases the nutrition in the soil, making
crops grow to great size. It has been
hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/landorus/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/landorus/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Kyurem
records.description:
This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a
hero to fill in the missing parts of its
body with truth or ideals. Its body became
frozen when its energy leaked out.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/kyurem/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/kyurem/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Keldeo
records.description:
When it is resolute, its body fills with
power and it becomes swifter. It crosses
the world, running over the surfaces of
oceans and rivers.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/keldeo/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/keldeo/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Meloetta
records.description:
The melodies sung by Meloetta have the
power to make Pokémon that hear them
happy or sad. Many famous songs have been
inspired by the tunes that Meloetta plays.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/meloetta/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/meloetta/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Genesect
records.description:
Over 300 million years ago, it was
feared as the strongest of hunters.
Team Plasma altered it and attached
a cannon to its back.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/species_info.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/genesect/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/genesect/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Chespin
records.description:
The quills on its head are usually soft.
When it flexes them, the points become
so hard and sharp that they can pierce
rock without any effort.

records.name: Quilladin
records.description:
They strengthen the sturdy shell covering
their bodies by running into one another.
They are very kind and won't start fights,
but will counterattack with sharp quills.

records.name: Chesnaught
records.description:
It shields its allies from danger with
its own body. When it takes a defensive
posture with its fists guarding its face,
it can withstand a bomb blast.

records.name: Fennekin
records.description:
As it walks, it munches on a twig to fill
itself with energy in place of a snack.
It intimidates opponents by puffing hot
air out of its roomy ears.

records.name: Braixen
records.description:
Braixen has a twig stuck in its tail.
When the twig is plucked from its tail,
friction sets the twig alight. The flame
is used to send signals to its allies.

records.name: Delphox
records.description:
It gazes into the flame at the tip of its
branch to achieve a focused state, which
allows it to see into the future. It uses
psychic power to incinerate its foes.

records.name: Froakie
records.description:
It protects its skin by covering its body
in bubbles it secretes from its chest and
back. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it
keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

records.name: Frogadier
records.description:
It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with
precise control, hitting empty cans up to
a hundred feet away. Frogadier's swiftness
is unparalleled.

records.name: Greninja
records.description:
It appears and vanishes with a ninja's
grace. It toys with its enemies using swift
movements, while slicing them with throwing
stars made of compressed water.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_6.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/species_info.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/greninja/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/greninja/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Bunnelby
records.description:
It has ears like shovels. Digging holes
strengthens its ears so much that they
can sever thick roots effortlessly.
Bunnelby dig the whole night through.

records.name: Diggersby
records.description:
With its powerful ears it reduces dense
bedrock to rubble. It can be a big help
at construction sites. When it's finished
digging, it lounges about lazily.

records.name: Fletchling
records.description:
This amiable Pokémon is easy to train.
But when battle is joined, it shows its
ferocious side. It's merciless to
intruders that enter its territory.

records.name: Flechinder
records.description:
From its beak, it expels embers that set
the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on
any bewildered Pokémon that pop out of
the grass.

records.name: Talonflame
records.description:
In the fever of an exciting battle, it
showers embers from the gaps between its
feathers and takes to the air. It finishes
its prey off with a colossal kick.

records.name: Scatterbug
records.description:
When under attack from bird Pokémon,
it spews a poisonous black powder that
causes paralysis on contact. Scatterbug
can live in any region or climate.

records.name: Spewpa
records.description:
It lives hidden within thicket shadows.
When predators attack, it quickly bristles
the fur covering its body in an effort to
threaten them.

records.name: Vivillon
records.description:
Its pattern depends on the climate and
topography of the land it was born in.
This form is from frigid lands.
It scatters toxic color scales in battle.

records.name: Litleo
records.description:
They set off on their own from their pride
and live by themselves to become stronger.
These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick
to start a fight.

records.name: Pyroar
records.description:
The male with the largest mane of fire
is the leader of the pride. The females
protect the pride's cubs. They viciously
threaten any challenger.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_6.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/pyroar/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/pyroar/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Flabébé
records.description:
This Flabébé rides a red flower.
Immediately after birth, this Pokémon
begins flying around in search of a
flower it likes.

records.name: Floette
records.description:
This Pokémon uses red wavelengths
of light to pour its own energy
into flowers and draw forth their
latent potential.

records.name: Florges
records.description:
This Pokémon creates an
impressive flower garden in its territory. It
draws forth the power of the red
flowers around its neck.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_6.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/florges/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/florges/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Skiddo
records.description:
If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't
need to eat, because it can generate
energy from the leaves on its back.
It has a placid disposition.

records.name: Gogoat
records.description:
It can tell how its trainer is feeling by
subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This
empathetic sense lets them run as if one
being. They inhabit mountainous regions.

records.name: Pancham
records.description:
There's no point to the leaf in its mouth,
aside from an effort to look cool. It's
mischievous, so it's not well suited to
inexperienced Trainers.

next.method: Level up at 32 with a Dark-type Pokémon in party

records.name: Pangoro
records.description:
It boasts superb physical strength.
Those who wish to become Pangoro's
Trainer have no choice but to converse
with their fists.

prev.method: Level up at 32 with a Dark-type Pokémon in party

records.name: Furfrou
records.description:
Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes
it more elegant but also increases the
swiftness of its movements. These
Pokémon were the guardians of kings.

records.name: Espurr
records.description:
It has enough psychic energy to blast
everything within 300 feet of itself.
The organ that emits its intense psychic
power is sheltered by its ears.

records.name: Meowstic
records.description:
The defensive instinct of the
males is strong. It's when they're
protecting themselves or their partners
that they unleash their full power.

records.name: Honedge
records.description:
If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it
wraps a blue cloth around that person's
arm and drains that person's life
energy completely.

records.name: Doublade
records.description:
When Honedge evolves, it divides into
two swords. The complex attack patterns
of its two swords are unstoppable, even
against those skilled at swordplay.

records.name: Aegislash
records.description:
In this defensive stance,
Aegislash uses its steel body and a force
field of spectral power to reduce the
damage of any attack.

records.name: Spritzee
records.description:
In the past, rather than using perfume,
royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would
waft a fragrance they liked. Its fragrance
changes depending on what it has eaten.

records.name: Aromatisse
records.description:
Its scent is so overpowering that,
unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy
the smell, he or she will have a hard time
walking alongside it.

records.name: Swirlix
records.description:
Because it eats nothing but sweets, its
fur is as sticky sweet as cotton candy.
To entangle its opponents in battle, it
extrudes sticky white threads.

records.name: Slurpuff
records.description:
Slurpuff can distinguish even the
faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive
sense of smell to use by helping pastry
chefs in their work.

records.name: Inkay
records.description:
It flashes the light-emitting spots on its
body, which drains its opponent's will
to fight. It takes the opportunity to
scuttle away and hide.

records.name: Malamar
records.description:
It lures prey close with hypnotic motions,
then wraps its tentacles around it before
finishing it off with digestive fluids. It
forces others to do whatever it wants.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_6.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/malamar/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/malamar/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Binacle
records.description:
They stretch and then contract, yanking
their rocks along with them in bold hops.
They eat seaweed that washes up on
the shoreline.

records.name: Barbaracle
records.description:
Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds
of their own, and they will move
independently. But they usually follow
the head's orders.

records.name: Skrelp
records.description:
Camouflaged as rotten kelp, it hides
from foes while storing up power for its
evolution. They spray liquid poison on
prey that approach unawares.

records.name: Dragalge
records.description:
Their poison is strong enough to eat
through the hull of a tanker. Tales are
told of ships that wander into seas where
Dragalge live, never to return.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_6.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/dragalge/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/dragalge/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Clauncher
records.description:
Through controlled expulsions of internal
gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot.
At close distances, it can even shatter
large rocks.

records.name: Clawitzer
records.description:
By expelling water from the nozzle in the
back of its enormous claw, it can move
at a speed of 60 knots. They launch
cannonballs made of water.

records.name: Helioptile
records.description:
They make their home in deserts.
They can generate their own energy from
basking in the sun, so eating food is not
a requirement.

records.name: Heliolisk
records.description:
A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient
electricity to power a skyscraper. It can
stimulate its muscles with electricity,
boosting the strength in its legs.

records.name: Tyrunt
records.description:
Its immense jaws have enough destructive
force that it can chew up a car. If
something happens that it doesn't like,
it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

records.name: Tyrantrum
records.description:
Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could
shred thick metal plates as if they were
paper, it was invincible in the ancient
world it once inhabited.

records.name: Amaura
records.description:
This ancient Pokémon was restored from
part of its body that had been frozen in
ice for over 100 million years. It lived in a
cold land where there were no predators.

records.name: Aurorus
records.description:
Using the diamond-shaped crystals on its
body it can instantly create a wall of ice
to block an opponent's attack, or encase
them in ice.

records.name: Sylveon
records.description:
Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura
that weakens hostility in its prey, causing
them to let down their guard. A moment
later, it pounces.

records.name: Hawlucha
records.description:
With its wings, it controls its position in
the air. Its proficient fighting skills
enable it to keep up with big bruisers
like Machamp and Hariyama.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_6.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/hawlucha/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/hawlucha/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Dedenne
records.description:
Its whiskers serve as antennas.
By sending and receiving electrical
waves, it can communicate with others
over vast distances.

records.name: Carbink
records.description:
Born from the high temperatures and
pressures deep underground, it defends
itself by firing beams from the jewel part
of its body.

records.name: Goomy
records.description:
Its source of protection is its slimy,
germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone
who touches it will need some thorough
hand-washing.

records.name: Sliggoo
records.description:
This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve
anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous
on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved,
it slurps them up.

next.method: Level up at 50 while it is raining

records.name: Goodra
records.description:
It gets picked on because it's meek.
But then, whoever teased it gets to feel
the full force of its horns and a good
swatting from its thick tail.

prev.method: Level up at 50 while it is raining

records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_6.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/goodra/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/goodra/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Klefki
records.description:
These key collectors threaten any
attackers by fiercely jingling their keys
at them. It will sneak into people's homes
to steal their keys.

records.name: Phantump
records.description:
According to legend, medicine to cure
any illness can be made by plucking the
green leaves on its head, brewing them,
and boiling down the liquid.

records.name: Trevenant
records.description:
Through its roots, it exerts control over
other trees. A deadly curse falls upon
anyone cutting down trees in forests
where Trevenant dwell.

records.name: Pumpkaboo
records.description:
The light that streams out from
the holes in the pumpkin can
hypnotize and control the people and
