Pokémon that see it.

records.name: Gourgeist
records.description:
Eerie cries emanate from its body
in the dead of night. The sounds are
said to be the wails of spirits who
are suffering in the afterlife.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_6.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/gourgeist/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/gourgeist/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Bergmite
records.description:
It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice
that shields its body. It uses cold air to
repair any cracks with new ice. They live
in herds on snowy mountains.

records.name: Avalugg
records.description:
The way several Bergmite huddle on its
back make it look like an aircraft carrier
made of ice. Its cumbersome frame crushes
anything that stands in its way.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_6.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/avalugg/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/avalugg/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Noibat
records.description:
They live in pitch-black caves. Even a
robust wrestler will become dizzy and
unable to stand when exposed to its
200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

records.name: Noivern
records.description:
They fly around on moonless nights and
attack careless prey. The ultrasonic waves
it emits from its ears can reduce a large
boulder to pebbles.

records.name: Xerneas
records.description:
Legends say that when the horns on
its head shine in seven colors, it is
sharing everlasting life. It slept for a
thousand years in the form of a tree
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_6.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/species_info.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/xerneas/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/xerneas/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Yveltal
records.description:
When its life comes to an end, its wings
and tail spread wide and glow red, and
it absorbs the life energy of every living
thing and turns into a cocoon.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_6.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/yveltal/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/yveltal/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Zygarde
records.description:
It's said to be monitoring the ecosystem
from deep in the caves where it lives.
There are rumors that even greater power
lies hidden within its cells.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_6.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/species_info.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/zygarde/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/zygarde/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Diancie
records.description:
A sudden transformation of Carbink,
its pink, glimmering body is said to be
the loveliest sight in the whole world.
It creates diamonds between its hands.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_6.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/diancie/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/diancie/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Hoopa
records.description:
In its true form, it possess a huge amount
of power. When its powers are sealed away,
it is transformed into a much smaller form.
It teleports things to a secret place.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_6.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/hoopa/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/hoopa/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Volcanion
records.description:
It lets out billows of steam from the arms
on its back and disappears into the dense
fog. It's said to live in mountains where
humans do not tread.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_6.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/volcanion/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/volcanion/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Rowlet
records.description:
This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis
to store up energy during the day, while
becoming active at night. Silently it
glides, drawing near to its target.

records.name: Dartrix
records.description:
A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time
preening its wings. Its preoccupation
with any dirt on its plumage can leave
it unable to battle.

records.name: Decidueye
records.description:
Decidueye is cool and cautious.
It fires arrow quills from its wings with
such precision, they can pierce a pebble
at distances of over a hundred yards.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/decidueye/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/decidueye/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Litten
records.description:
While grooming itself, it builds up fur
inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight
and spews fiery attacks, which change
based on how it coughs.

records.name: Torracat
records.description:
At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The
bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon
spits fire. With a single punch, it can bend
an iron bar right over.

records.name: Incineroar
records.description:
This Pokémon has a violent, selfish
disposition. If it's not in the mood to
listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders
with complete nonchalance.

records.name: Popplio
records.description:
This Pokémon snorts body fluids from
its nose, blowing balloons to smash into
its foes. It practices diligently so it can
learn to make big bubbles.

records.name: Brionne
records.description:
It cares deeply for its companions.
When its Trainer is feeling down, it
performs a cheery dance with a sequence
of water balloons  to try and help.

records.name: Primarina
records.description:
It controls its water balloons with song.
The melody is learned from others of
its kind and is passed down from one
generation to the next.

records.name: Pikipek
records.description:
This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose
leftover seeds become the ammunition for
the attacks it fires off from its mouth.
It uses holes in trees for nesting.

records.name: Trumbeak
records.description:
By bending its beak, it can produce a
variety of calls and brand itself a noisy
nuisance for its neighbors. It eats
berries and stores their seeds in its beak.

records.name: Toucannon
records.description:
When it battles, within its beak, its
internal gases ignite, explosively
launching seeds with enough power to
pulverize boulders.

records.name: Yungoos
records.description:
With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything.
It wanders around in a never-ending
search for food. At dusk, it collapses
and falls asleep on the spot.

records.name: Gumshoos
records.description:
When it finds a trace of its prey, it
patiently stakes out the location...
but as it's diurnal, it's always snoozing
by nightfall.

records.name: Grubbin
records.description:
They often gather near places frequented
by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being
attacked by bird Pokémon, though it
normally lives underground.

records.name: Charjabug
records.description:
From the food it digests, it generates
electricity, and it stores this energy in
its electric sac. On camping trips, people
are grateful to have one around.

records.name: Vikavolt
records.description:
It concentrates electrical energy within
its large jaws and uses it to zap its foes.
It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking
beams of electrical energy.

records.name: Crabrawler
records.description:
While guarding its weak points with its
pincers, it looks for an opening and
unleashes punches. When it loses, it
foams at the mouth and faints.

records.name: Crabminabl
records.description:
It aimed for the top but got lost and
ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced
to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved
and grew thick fur.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/crabominable/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/crabominable/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Oricorio
records.description:
It wins the hearts of its enemies
with its passionate dancing and then
uses the opening it creates to
burn them up with blazing flames.

records.name: Cutiefly
records.description:
Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the
heads of people who have auras resembling
those of flowers. It can identify which
flowers are about to bloom.

records.name: Ribombee
records.description:
Ribombee rolls up pollen into puffs.
It makes many different varieties, some
used as food and others used in battle.
They are sometimes sold as supplements.

records.name: Rockruff
records.description:
This Pokémon has lived with people since
times long ago. It can sense when its
Trainer is in the dumps and will stick
close by its Trainer's side.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/species_info.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/rockruff/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/rockruff/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Lycanroc
records.description:
It has a calm and collected
demeanor. It swiftly closes in on its prey,
then slices them with the rocks in
its mane.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/lycanroc/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/lycanroc/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Wishiwashi
records.description:
Individually, they're incredibly
weak. It's by gathering up into
schools that they're able to confront
opponents.

records.name: Mareanie
records.description:
It's found crawling on beaches and
seafloors. The coral that grows on
Corsola's head is as good as a five-star
banquet to this Pokémon.

records.name: Toxapex
records.description:
Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will
suffer intense pain for three days and
three nights. Post-recovery, there will be
some aftereffects.

records.name: Mudbray
records.description:
The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves
enhances its grip and its powerful running
gait. Eating dirt, making mud, and playing
in the mire form its daily routine.

records.name: Mudsdale
records.description:
Its heavy, mud-covered kicks are its
best means of attack, and it can reduce
large trucks to scrap without breaking
a sweat.

records.name: Dewpider
records.description:
It crawls onto the land in search of food.
When it comes across enemies or potential
prey, this Pokémon smashes its
water-bubble-covered head into them.

records.name: Araquanid
records.description:
Despite what its appearance suggests,
it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable,
weak Pokémon, it protectively brings
them into its water bubble.

records.name: Fomantis
records.description:
During the day, it sleeps and soaks up
light. They give off a sweet and refreshing
scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall
grass where Fomantis are hiding.

records.name: Lurantis
records.description:
It requires a lot of effort to maintain
Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some
collectors enjoy this work and treat it
as their hobby.

records.name: Morelull
records.description:
As it drowses the day away, it nourishes
itself by sucking from tree roots.
It wakens at the fall of night, wandering
off in search of a new tree.

records.name: Shiinotic
records.description:
Forests where Shiinotic live are
treacherous to enter at night.
People confused by its strange lights
can never find their way home again.

records.name: Salandit
records.description:
It burns its bodily fluids to create a
sweet-smelling poisonous gas. When its
enemies become disoriented from inhaling
the gas, it attacks them.

records.name: Salazzle
records.description:
For some reason, only females have
been found. It creates a reverse harem of
male Salandit to live with. Its poisonous
gas is filled with pheromones.

records.name: Stufful
records.description:
Despite its adorable appearance, when it
gets angry and flails about, its arms and
legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
It's an incredibly dangerous Pokémon.

records.name: Bewear
records.description:
This Pokémon has the habit of hugging its
companions. Many Trainers have left this
world after their spines were squashed
by its hug.

records.name: Bounsweet
records.description:
A delectable aroma pours from its body. 
Bounsweet's sweat can be watered down
into a juice with just the right amount
of sweetness.

records.name: Steenee
records.description:
The sepals on its head developed to
protect its body. These are quite hard, so
even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this
Pokémon is totally fine.

records.name: Tsareena
records.description:
Its long, striking legs aren't just for
show but to be used to kick with skill.
In victory, it shows off by kicking the
defeated, laughing boisterously.

records.name: Comfey
records.description:
It attaches flowers to its nutritious
vine. Baths prepared with the flowers
from its vine have a relaxing effect, so
this Pokémon is a hit with many people.

records.name: Oranguru
records.description:
Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty
canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare
occasions, it shows up at the beach to
match wits with Slowking.

records.name: Passimian
records.description:
They battle with hard berries for weapons.
They form groups of about 20 individuals.
Their techniques are passed from the boss
to the group, generation upon generation.

records.name: Wimpod
records.description:
This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately
dashes off, the flailing of its many legs
leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
It lives on beaches and seabeds.

records.name: Golisopod
records.description:
It battles skillfully with its six arms,
with a flashing slash of its giant sharp
claws, it cleaves seawater--or even
air--right in two.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/golisopod/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/golisopod/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Sandygast
records.description:
It takes control of anyone who puts a hand
in its mouth, to add to the accumulation
of its sand-mound body. This Pokémon
embodies the grudges of the departed.

records.name: Palossand
records.description:
Possessed people controlled by this
Pokémon transformed its sand mound into
a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse
grew ever stronger.

records.name: Pyukumuku
records.description:
It lives in shallow seas, such as areas
near a beach. The sticky mucous that
covers their bodies can be used to soothe
sunburned skin. How convenient!

records.name: Type: Null
records.description:
Due to the danger that this synthetic
Pokémon may go on a rampage, it wears a
control mask to restrain its capabilities.
It has some hidden special power.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/type_null/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/type_null/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Silvally
records.description:
Its trust in its partner awakens it.
This Pokémon is capable of changing its
type by equipping special memories, a
trait that is well displayed in battle.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/silvally/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/silvally/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Komala
records.description:
It is born asleep, and it dies asleep.
All its movements are apparently no more
than the results of it tossing and turning
in its dreams.

records.name: Turtonator
records.description:
The shell on its back is chemically
unstable and explodes violently if struck.
The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
It gushes fire from its nostrils.

records.name: Togedemaru
records.description:
The spiny fur on its back is normally
at rest. When this Pokémon becomes
agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs
into its attackers.

records.name: Mimikyu
records.description:
A lonely Pokémon, it hides its terrifying
appearance beneath an old rag so it can
get closer to people and other Pokémon.
Its actual appearance is unknown.

records.name: Bruxish
records.description:
It stuns its prey with its psychic powers
and then grinds them to mush with its
strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no
match for it.

records.name: Drampa
records.description:
This Pokémon is friendly to people and
loves children most of all. It comes from
deep in the mountains to play with
children it likes in town.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/drampa/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/drampa/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Dhelmise
records.description:
The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves
became reborn as this Pokémon.
It maintains itself with new infusions of
seabed detritus and seaweed.

records.name: Jangmo-o
records.description:
It expresses its feelings by smacking its
scales. Metallic sounds echo through the
tall mountains where Jangmo-o live. They
grow little by little battling one another.

records.name: Hakamo-o
records.description:
It sheds and regrows its scales on a
continuous basis. The scales become
harder each time they're regrown. Its
scaly punches tear its foes to shreds.

records.name: Kommo-o
records.description:
Its rigid scales function as offense and
defense. In the past, its scales were
processed and used to make weapons
and other valuable commodities.

records.name: Tapu Koko
records.description:
It confuses its enemies by flying too
quickly for the eye to follow. It has a
hair-trigger temper but forgets what
made it angry an instant later.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/tapu_koko/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/tapu_koko/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Tapu Lele
records.description:
A fragrant aroma of flowers follows it.
As it flutters about, it scatters its
strangely glowing scales. Touching them
is said to restore good health.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/tapu_lele/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/tapu_lele/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Tapu Bulu
records.description:
It causes vegetation to grow, and then
it absorbs energy from the growth.
It pulls large trees up by the roots and
swings them around at its enemies.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/tapu_bulu/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/tapu_bulu/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Tapu Fini
records.description:
People say it can create pure water that
will wash away any corruption. The dense
fog it creates brings the downfall and
destruction of its confused enemies.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/tapu_fini/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/tapu_fini/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Cosmog
records.description:
In ages past, it was called the child of
the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from
another world, but no specific details
are known.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Cosmoem
records.description:
Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly
warm to the touch. There's something
accumulating around the black core
within its hard shell.

records.name: Solgaleo
records.description:
It is said to live in another world.
The intense light it radiates from the
surface of its body can make the darkest
of nights light up like midday.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/solgaleo/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/solgaleo/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Lunala
records.description:
When its third eye activates, away it flies
to another world. This Pokémon devours
light, drawing the moonless dark veil of
night over the brightness of day.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/lunala/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/lunala/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Nihilego
records.description:
One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts.
It's unclear whether or not this Pokémon
is sentient, but sometimes it can be
observed behaving like a young girl.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/nihilego/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/nihilego/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Buzzwole
records.description:
This life-form called an Ultra Beast
appeared from another world. It shows
off its body, but whether that display
is a boast or a threat remains unclear.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/buzzwole/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/buzzwole/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Pheromosa
records.description:
One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts,
it refuses to touch anything, perhaps
because it senses some uncleanness
in this world.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/pheromosa/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/pheromosa/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Xurkitree
records.description:
One of the mysterious life-forms known
as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric
shocks emanate from its entire body,
according to witnesses.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/xurkitree/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/xurkitree/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Celesteela
records.description:
It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole.
One kind of Ultra Beast, witnesses saw
it flying across the sky by expelling gas
from its two arms.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/celesteela/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/celesteela/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Kartana
records.description:
This Ultra Beast came from the
Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack
enemies on its own, but its sharp body is
a dangerous weapon in itself.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Guzzlord
records.description:
A dangerous Ultra Beast, it has gobbled
mountains and swallowed whole buildings,
according to reports. But for some reason
its droppings have never been found.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/guzzlord/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/guzzlord/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Necrozma
records.description:
Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this
life-form, apparently asleep underground,
is thought to have come from another
world in ancient times.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/necrozma/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/necrozma/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Magearna
records.description:
This artificial Pokémon, constructed more
than 500 years ago, can understand human
speech but cannot itself speak. Its true
self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/magearna/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/magearna/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Marshadow
records.description:
Able to conceal itself in the shadows of
others, it never appears before humans,
so its very existence is the stuff of myth.
This Pokémon is craven and cowering.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Poipole
records.description:
This Ultra Beast is well enough
liked to be chosen as a
first partner in its own world.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Naganadel
records.description:
It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous
liquid inside its body. It is one of the
organisms known as UBs.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/naganadel/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/naganadel/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Stakataka
records.description:
It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each
one appears to be made up of many life-
forms stacked one on top of each other.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/stakataka/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/stakataka/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Blacephaln
records.description:
It slithers toward people and explode
its head without warning. It is
one kind of Ultra Beast.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Zeraora
records.description:
It approaches its enemies at the speed
of lightning, then tears them limb from
limb with its sharp claws.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/zeraora/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/zeraora/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Meltan
records.description:
It melts particles of iron and other metals
found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them
into its body of molten steel.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Melmetal
records.description:
Revered long ago for its capacity to create
iron from nothing, for some reason it has
come back to life after 3,000 years.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_7.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/melmetal/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/melmetal/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Grookey
records.description:
When it uses its special stick to strike up
a beat, the sound waves produced carry
revitalizing energy to the plants and
flowers in the area.

records.name: Thwackey
records.description:
The faster a Thwackey can beat out
a rhythm with its two sticks, the more
respect it wins from its peers.

records.name: Rillaboom
records.description:
By drumming, it taps into the power of
its special tree stump. The roots of the
stump follow its direction in battle.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/rillaboom/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/rillaboom/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Scorbunny
records.description:
A warm-up of running around gets fire
energy coursing through this Pokémon's
body. Once that happens, it's ready to
fight at full power.

records.name: Raboot
records.description:
Its thick and fluffy fur protects it
from the cold and enables it to use
hotter fire moves.

records.name: Cinderace
records.description:
It juggles a pebble with its feet,
turning it into a burning soccer ball.
Its shots strike opponents hard and
leave them scorched.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/cinderace/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/cinderace/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Sobble
records.description:
When scared, this Pokémon cries.
Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100
onions, and attackers won't be
able to resist weeping.

records.name: Drizzile
records.description:
A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles
using water balloons created with
moisture secreted from its palms.

records.name: Inteleon
records.description:
It has many hidden capabilities, such as
fingertips that can shoot water and a
membrane on its back that it can use to
glide through the air.

records.name: Skwovet
records.description:
Found throughout the Galar region, this
Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are
ever completely empty of berries.

records.name: Greedent
records.description:
It stashes berries in its tail--so many
berries that they fall out constantly.
But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted,
so it doesn't notice the loss.

records.name: Rookidee
records.description:
It will bravely challenge any opponent,
no matter how powerful. This Pokémon
benefits from every battle--even a defeat
increases its strength a bit.

records.name: Corvisquir
records.description:
Smart enough to use tools in battle,
these Pokémon have been seen picking up
rocks and flinging them or using ropes
to wrap up enemies.

records.name: Corviknigh
records.description:
This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies
of the Galar region. The black luster of
its steel body could drive terror into
the heart of any foe.

records.name: Blipbug
records.description:
A constant collector of information,
this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong
is what it isn't.

records.name: Dottler
records.description:
It barely moves, but it's still alive.
Hiding in its shell without food or
water seems to have awakened its
psychic powers.

records.name: Orbeetle
records.description:
It's famous for its high level of
intelligence, and the large size of its
brain is proof that it also possesses
immense psychic power.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/orbeetle/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/orbeetle/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Nickit
records.description:
Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it
silently raids the food stores of other
Pokémon. It survives off its
ill-gotten gains.

records.name: Thievul
records.description:
It secretly marks potential targets with
a scent. By following the scent, it
stalks its targets and steals from them
when they least expect it.

records.name: Gossifleur
records.description:
It anchors itself in the ground with its
single leg, then basks in the sun. After
absorbing enough sunlight, its petals
spread as it blooms brilliantly.

records.name: Eldegoss
records.description:
The seeds attached to its cotton fluff
are full of nutrients. It spreads them
on the wind so that plants and other
Pokémon can benefit from them.

records.name: Wooloo
records.description:
Its curly fleece is such an effective
cushion that this Pokémon could fall off
a cliff and stand right back up at the
bottom, unharmed.

records.name: Dubwool
records.description:
Weave a carpet from its springy wool,
and you end up with something closer to
a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the
moment you set foot on it.

records.name: Chewtle
records.description:
Apparently the itch of its teething
impels it to snap its jaws at anything
in front of it.

records.name: Drednaw
records.description:
With jaws that can shear through steel
rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon
chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/drednaw/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/drednaw/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Yamper
records.description:
This Pokémon is very popular as a
herding dog in the Galar region. As it
runs, it generates electricity from the
base of its tail.

records.name: Boltund
records.description:
This Pokémon generates electricity and
channels it into its legs to keep them
going strong. Boltund can run nonstop
for three full days.

records.name: Rolycoly
records.description:
Most of its body has the same composition
as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was
first discovered in coal mines about
400 years ago.

records.name: Carkol
records.description:
It forms coal inside its body. Coal
dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel
the lives of people in the Galar region.

records.name: Coalossal
records.description:
It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism
of mines enrages it. Offenders will be
incinerated with flames that reach
2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/coalossal/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/coalossal/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Applin
records.description:
It spends its entire life inside an
apple. It hides from its natural enemies,
bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an
apple and nothing more.

records.name: Flapple
records.description:
It ate a sour apple, and that induced its
evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid
capable of causing chemical burns.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/flapple/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/flapple/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Appletun
records.description:
Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution.
A nectarous scent wafts from its body,
luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/appletun/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/appletun/anim_front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Silicobra
records.description:
As it digs, it swallows sand and stores
it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold
more than 17 pounds of sand.

records.name: Sandaconda
records.description:
When it contracts its body, over 220
pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If
it ever runs out of sand, it becomes
disheartened.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/sandaconda/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/sandaconda/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Cramorant
records.description:
It's so strong that it can knock out some
opponents in a single hit, but it also may
forget what it's battling midfight.

records.name: Arrokuda
records.description:
If it sees any movement around it, this
Pokémon charges for it straightaway,
leading with its sharply pointed jaw.
It's very proud of that jaw.

records.name: Barraskewd
records.description:
This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp
as a spear and as strong as steel.
Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is
surprisingly tasty, too.

records.name: Toxel
records.description:
It stores poison in an internal poison
sac and secretes that poison through its
skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a
tingling sensation follows.

next.method: Level up at 30 with an amp-up nature

records.name: Toxtricity
records.description:
When this Pokémon sounds as if it's
strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing
at the protrusions on its chest to
generate electricity.

prev.method: Level up at 30 with an amp-up nature

records.name: Sizzlipede
records.description:
It stores flammable gas in its body and
uses it to generate heat. The yellow
sections on its belly get particularly hot.

records.name: Centiskorc
records.description:
When it heats up, its body temperature
reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
It lashes its body like a whip and
launches itself at enemies.

records.name: Clobbopus
records.description:
It's very curious, but its means of
investigating things is to try to punch
them with its tentacles. The search for
food is what brings it onto land.

records.name: Grapploct
records.description:
A body made up of nothing but muscle makes
the grappling moves this Pokémon performs
with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

records.name: Sinistea
records.description:
This Pokémon is said to have been born
when a lonely spirit possessed a cold,
leftover cup of tea.

records.name: Polteageis
records.description:
This species lives in antique teapots.
Most pots are forgeries, but on rare
occasions, an authentic work is found.

records.name: Hatenna
records.description:
Via the protrusion on its head, it senses
other creatures' emotions. If you don't
have a calm disposition, it will never
warm up to you.

records.name: Hattrem
records.description:
No matter who you are, if you bring strong
emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence
you violently.

records.name: Hatterene
records.description:
It emits psychic power strong enough to
cause headaches as a deterrent to the
approach of others.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/hatterene/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/hatterene/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Impidimp
records.description:
Through its nose, it sucks in the
emanations produced by people and Pokémon
when they feel annoyed. It thrives off
this negative energy.

records.name: Morgrem
records.description:
When it gets down on all fours as if to
beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure
opponents in so that it can stab them
with its spear-like hair.

records.name: Grimmsnarl
records.description:
With the hair wrapped around its body
helping to enhance its muscles, this
Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/grimmsnarl/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/grimmsnarl/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Obstagoon
records.description:
Its voice is staggering in volume.
Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a
threatening posture and shout--this move
is known as Obstruct.

records.name: Perrserker
records.description:
What appears to be an iron helmet is
actually hardened hair. This Pokémon
lives for the thrill of battle.

records.name: Cursola
records.description:
Its shell is overflowing with its
heightened otherworldly energy. The
ectoplasm serves as protection for this
Pokémon's core spirit.

records.name: Sirfetch'd
records.description:
Only Farfetch'd that have survived many
battles can attain this evolution. When
this Pokémon's leek withers, it will
retire from combat.

records.name: Mr. Rime
records.description:
It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It
waves its cane of ice in time with its
graceful movements.

records.name: Runerigus
records.description:
A powerful curse was woven into an ancient
painting. After absorbing the spirit of
a Yamask, the painting began to move.

records.name: Milcery
records.description:
This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling
particles in the air. Its body is made
of cream.

records.name: Alcremie
records.description:
When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat
them to berries it's decorated with cream.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/species_info.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/alcremie/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/alcremie/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Falinks
records.description:
Five of them are troopers, and one is the
brass. The brass's orders are absolute.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/falinks/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/falinks/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Pincurchin
records.description:
It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to
scrape it off rocks. Electric current
flows from the tips of its spines.

records.name: Snom
records.description:
It spits out thread imbued with a frigid
sort of energy and uses it to tie its body
to branches, disguising itself as an
icicle while it sleeps.

records.name: Frosmoth
records.description:
Icy scales fall from its wings like snow
as it flies over fields and mountains.
The temperature of its wings is less than
-290 degrees Fahrenheit.

records.name: Stonjourne
records.description:
It stands in grasslands, watching the
sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This
Pokémon has a talent for delivering
dynamic kicks.

records.name: Eiscue
records.description:
It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters
from a frigid place. It keeps its head
iced constantly to make sure it stays
nice and cold.

records.name: Indeedee
records.description:
It uses the horns on its head to sense the
emotions of others. Males will act as
valets for those they serve, looking
after their every need.

records.name: Morpeko
records.description:
As it eats the seeds stored up in its
pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not
just satisfying its constant hunger. It's
also generating electricity.

records.name: Cufant
records.description:
It digs up the ground with its trunk.
It's also very strong, being able to
carry loads of over five tons without any
problem at all.

records.name: Copperajah
records.description:
They came over from another region long
ago and worked together with humans.
Their green skin is resistant to water.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/copperajah/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/copperajah/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Dracozolt
records.description:
In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks
to its powerful lower body, but it went
extinct anyway after it depleted all its
plant-based food sources.

records.name: Arctozolt
records.description:
The shaking of its freezing upper half is
what generates its electricity. It has a
hard time walking around.

records.name: Dracovish
records.description:
Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex
predator of its time. Its own overhunting
of its prey was what drove it to
extinction.

records.name: Arctovish
records.description:
Though it's able to capture prey by
freezing its surroundings, it has trouble
eating the prey afterward because its
mouth is on top of its head.

records.name: Duraludon
records.description:
Its body resembles polished metal, and
it's both lightweight and strong. The only
drawback is that it rusts easily.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/duraludon/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/duraludon/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Dreepy
records.description:
After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon,
Dreepy wanders the areas it used to
inhabit back when it was alive in
prehistoric seas.

records.name: Drakloak
records.description:
It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph.
It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes
on them until they successfully evolve.

records.name: Dragapult
records.description:
When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy
in the holes on its horns. Once a fight
starts, it launches the Dreepy like
supersonic missiles.

records.name: Zacian
records.description:
Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon
absorbs metal particles, transforming them
into a weapon it uses to battle.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/zacian/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/zacian/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Zamazenta
records.description:
In times past, it worked together with a
king of the people to save the Galar
region. It absorbs metal that it then
uses in battle.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/zamazenta/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/zamazenta/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Eternatus
records.description:
The core on its chest absorbs energy
emanating from the lands of the Galar
region. This energy is what allows
Eternatus to stay active.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/eternatus/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/eternatus/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Kubfu
records.description:
Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves.
The moves it masters will determine which
form it takes when it evolves.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Urshifu
records.description:
This form of Urshifu is a strong believer
in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap
in close to foes and land a devastating
blow with a hardened fist.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/urshifu/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/urshifu/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Zarude
records.description:
Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives
in a pack with others of its kind. It's
incredibly aggressive, and the other
Pokémon of the forest fear it.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/zarude/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/zarude/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Regieleki
records.description:
This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical
energy. It's said that removing the rings
on Regieleki's body will unleash the
Pokémon's latent power.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/regieleki/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/regieleki/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Regidrago
records.description:
An academic theory proposes that
Regidrago's arms were once the head of an
ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory
remains unproven.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/regidrago/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/regidrago/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Glastrier
records.description:
Glastrier emits intense cold from its
hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon--
anything it wants, it takes by force.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/glastrier/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/glastrier/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Spectrier
records.description:
It probes its surroundings with all its
senses save one--it doesn't use its sense
of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to
separate soul from body.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/spectrier/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/spectrier/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Calyrex
records.description:
Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of
providing healing and blessings. It
reigned over the Galar region in times
of yore.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/calyrex/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/calyrex/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Wyrdeer
records.description:
The black orbs shine with an uncanny light
when it is erecting invisible barriers.
The fur shed from its beard retains heat
and is useful for winter clothing.

records.name: Kleavor
records.description:
A violent creature that fells trees with
its crude axes and shields itself with hard
stone. Should one encounter this Pokémon
in the wild, one's only recourse is to flee.

records.name: Ursaluna
records.description:
Swampy terrain gives Ursaluna its burly
physique and newfound capacity to
manipulate peat at will.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_2.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/ursaluna/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/ursaluna/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Bsculegion
records.description:
Clads itself in the souls of comrades that
perished before fulfilling their goals of
journeying upstream. No other species in
all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/basculegion/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/basculegion/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Sneasler
records.description:
Because of its wicked poison and daunting
physical prowess, no other species could
hope to best it on frozen highlands. It
prefers solitude and doesn't form packs.

records.name: Overqwil
records.description:
Its lancelike spikes and savage
temperament have earned it the
nickname “Sea Fiend”.
It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

records.name: Enamorus
records.description:
Its arrival brings an end to the winter.
According to legend, this Pokémon's love
gives rise to the budding of fresh life
across the land.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_8.h @origin/expansion; src/data/pokemon/form_species_tables.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/enamorus/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/enamorus/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Sprigatito
records.description:
The sweet scent its body gives off
mesmerizes those around it. The
scent grows stronger when this
Pokémon is in the sun.

records.name: Floragato
records.description:
Floragato deftly wields the vine
hidden beneath its long fur, slamming
the hard flower bud against its
opponents.

records.name: Meowscarad
records.description:
This Pokémon uses the reflective
fur lining its cape to camouflage the
stem of its flower, creating the
illusion that the flower is floating.

records.name: Fuecoco
records.description:
Its flame sac is small, so energy is
always leaking out. This energy is
released from the dent atop
Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

records.name: Crocalor
records.description:
The combination of Crocalor's fire
energy and overflowing vitality has
caused an egg-shaped fireball to
appear on the Pokémon's head.

records.name: Skeledirge
records.description:
Skeledirge's gentle singing
soothes the souls of all that hear it. It
burns its enemies to a crisp with
flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

records.name: Quaxly
records.description:
Its strong legs let it easily swim
around in even fast-flowing rivers.
It likes to keep things tidy and is
prone to overthinking things.

records.name: Quaxwell
records.description:
The hardworking Quaxwell observes
people and Pokémon from various
regions and incorporates their
movements into its own dance routines.

records.name: Quaquaval
records.description:
A single kick from a Quaquaval can
send a truck rolling. This Pokémon
uses its powerful legs to perform
striking dances from far-off lands.

records.name: Lechonk
records.description:
It searches for food all day. It
possesses a keen sense of smell but
doesn't use it for anything other
than foraging.

records.name: Oinkologne
records.description:
Oinkologne is proud of its fine,
glossy skin. It emits a concentrated
scent from the tip of its tail.

records.name: Tarountula
records.description:
The thread it secretes from its
rear is as strong as wire. The secret
behind the thread's strength is the
topic of ongoing research.

records.name: Spidops
records.description:
It clings to branches and ceilings
using its threads and moves without
a sound. It takes out its prey
before the prey even notices it.

records.name: Nymble
records.description:
It has its third set of legs folded
up. When it's in a tough spot, this
Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the
strength of its legs.

records.name: Lokix
records.description:
When it decides to fight all out, it
stands on its previously folded
legs to enter Showdown Mode. It
neutralizes its enemies in short order.

records.name: Pawmi
records.description:
The pads of its paws are
electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires
electricity from its forepaws while
standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

records.name: Pawmo
records.description:
When its group is attacked, Pawmo
is the first to leap into battle,
defeating enemies with a fighting
technique that utilizes electric shocks.

records.name: Pawmot
records.description:
This Pokémon normally is slow to
react, but once it enters battle, it
will strike down its enemies with
lightning-fast movements.

records.name: Tandemaus
records.description:
Exhibiting great teamwork, they
use their incisors to cut pieces out
of any material that might be useful
for a nest, then make off with them.

records.name: Maushold
records.description:
The little one just appeared one
day. They all live together like a
family, but the relationship between
the three is still unclear.

records.name: Fidough
records.description:
This Pokémon is smooth and moist
to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's
breath induces fermentation in the
Pokémon's vicinity.

records.name: Dachsbun
records.description:
The pleasant aroma that emanates
from this Pokémon's body helps
wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been
treasured by farming villages.

records.name: Smoliv
records.description:
This Pokémon converts nutrients
into oil, which it stores in the fruit
on its head. It can easily go a whole
week without eating or drinking.

records.name: Dolliv
records.description:
Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-
scented oil with others. This species
has coexisted with humans since
times long gone.

records.name: Arboliva
records.description:
This Pokémon drives back enemies
by launching its rich, aromatic oil at
them with enough force to smash a
boulder.

records.name: Sqawkabily
records.description:
Green-feathered flocks hold the
most sway. When they're out
searching for food in the mornings and
evenings, it gets very noisy.

records.name: Nacli
records.description:
The ground scrapes its body as it
travels, causing it to leave salt
behind. Salt is constantly being created
and replenished inside Nacli's body.

records.name: Naclstack
records.description:
It compresses rock salt inside its
body and shoots out hardened salt
pellets with enough force to
perforate an iron sheet.

records.name: Garganacl
records.description:
Garganacl will rub its fingertips
together and sprinkle injured
Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will
promptly heal afterward.

records.name: Charcadet
records.description:
Burnt charcoal came to life and
became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery
fighting spirit, Charcadet will
battle even tough opponents.

records.name: Armarouge
records.description:
Armarouge evolved through the use
of a set of armor that belonged to
a distinguished warrior. This
Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

records.name: Ceruledge
records.description:
The fiery blades on its arms burn
fiercely with the lingering
resentment of a sword wielder who fell
before accomplishing their goal.

records.name: Tadbulb
records.description:
Tadbulb shakes its tail to
generate electricity. If it senses danger,
it will make its head blink on and off
to alert its allies.

records.name: Bellibolt
records.description:
When this Pokémon expands and
contracts its wobbly body, the belly-
button dynamo in its stomach
produces a huge amount of electricity.

records.name: Wattrel
records.description:
When its wings catch the wind, the
bones within produce electricity.
This Pokémon dives into the ocean,
catching prey by electrocuting them.

records.name: Kilowatrel
records.description:
It uses its throat sac to store
electricity generated by its wings.
There's hardly any oil in its feathers,
so it is a poor swimmer.

records.name: Maschiff
records.description:
Its well-developed jaw and fangs
are strong enough to crunch through
boulders, and its thick fat makes
for an excellent defense.

records.name: Mabosstiff
records.description:
Mabosstiff loves playing with
children. Though usually gentle, it
takes on an intimidating look when
protecting its family.

records.name: Shroodle
records.description:
To keep enemies away from its
territory, it paints markings around its
nest using a poisonous liquid that
has an acrid odor.

records.name: Grafaiai
records.description:
Each Grafaiai paints its own
individual pattern, and it will paint that
same pattern over and over again
throughout its life.

records.name: Bramblin
records.description:
A soul unable to move on to the
afterlife was blown around by the wind
until it got tangled up with dried
grass and became a Pokémon.

records.name: Brmblghast
records.description:
It will open the branches of its
head to envelop its prey. Once it
absorbs all the life energy it needs, it
expels the prey and discards it.

records.name: Toedscool
records.description:
Though it looks like Tentacool,
Toedscool is a completely different
species. Its legs may be thin, but it
can run at a speed of 30 mph.

records.name: Toedscruel
records.description:
These Pokémon gather into groups
and form colonies deep within
forests. They absolutely hate it when
strangers approach.

records.name: Klawf
records.description:
Klawf hangs upside-down from
cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't
remain in this position for long
because its blood rushes to its head.

records.name: Capsakid
records.description:
The more sunlight this Pokémon
bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are
produced by its body, and thus the
spicier its moves become.

records.name: Scovillain
records.description:
The green head has turned vicious
due to the spicy chemicals
stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a
rampage, there is no stopping it.

records.name: Rellor
records.description:
This Pokémon creates a mud ball by
mixing sand and dirt with psychic
energy. It treasures its mud ball more
than its own life.

records.name: Rabsca
records.description:
The body that supports the ball
barely moves. Therefore, it is thought
that the true body of this Pokémon
is actually inside the ball.

records.name: Flittle
records.description:
Flittle's toes levitate about half
an inch above the ground because of
the psychic power emitted from the
frills on the Pokémon's belly.

records.name: Espathra
records.description:
It immobilizes opponents by
bathing them in psychic power from its
large eyes. Despite its appearance, it
has a vicious temperament.

records.name: Tinkatink
records.description:
This Pokémon pounds iron scraps
together to make a hammer. It will
remake the hammer again and again until
it's satisfied with the result.

records.name: Tinkatuff
records.description:
These Pokémon make their homes in
piles of scrap metal. They test the
strength of each other's hammers by
smashing them together.

records.name: Tinkaton
records.description:
The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it
gets swung around easily by
Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases
and carries its plunder back home.

records.name: Wiglett
records.description:
This Pokémon can pick up the scent
of a Veluza just over 65 feet away
and will hide itself in the sand.

records.name: Wugtrio
records.description:
A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio
was once considered to be a
regional form of Dugtrio.

records.name: Bombirdier
records.description:
Bombirdier uses the apron on its
chest to bundle up food, which it
carries back to its nest. It enjoys
dropping things that make loud noises.

records.name: Finizen
records.description:
Its water ring is made from
seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that
Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

records.name: Palafin
records.description:
This Pokémon changes its
appearance if it hears its allies calling for
help. Palafin will never show
anybody its moment of transformation.

records.name: Varoom
records.description:
The steel section is Varoom's
actual body. This Pokémon clings to
rocks and converts the minerals within
into energy to fuel its activities.

records.name: Revavroom
records.description:
It creates a gas out of poison and
minerals from rocks. It then
detonates the gas in its cylinders- now
numbering eight-to generate energy.

records.name: Cyclizar
records.description:
It can sprint at over 70 mph while
carrying a human. The rider's body
heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts
the Pokémon's spirit.

records.name: Orthworm
records.description:
When attacked, this Pokémon will
wield the tendrils on its body like
fists and pelt the opponent with a
storm of punches.

records.name: Glimmet
records.description:
Glimmet's toxic mineral crystals
look just like flower petals. This
Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like
pollen to protect itself.

records.name: Glimmora
records.description:
Glimmora's petals are made of
crystallized poison energy. It has
recently become evident that these
petals resemble Tera Jewels.

records.name: Greavard
records.description:
This friendly Pokémon doesn't like
being alone. Pay it even the
slightest bit of attention, and it will
follow you forever.

records.name: Houndstone
records.description:
Houndstone spends most of its
time sleeping in graveyards. Among all
the dog Pokémon, this one is most
loyal to its master.

records.name: Flamigo
records.description:
Thanks to a behavior of theirs
known as “synchronizing,” an entire
flock of these Pokémon can attack
simultaneously in perfect harmony.

records.name: Cetoddle
records.description:
This species left the ocean and
began living on land a very long time
ago. It seems to be closely related
to Wailmer.

records.name: Cetitan
records.description:
Ice energy builds up in the horn on
its upper jaw, causing the horn to
reach cryogenic temperatures that
freeze its surroundings.

records.name: Veluza
records.description:
Veluza has excellent regenerative
capabilities. It sheds spare flesh
from its body to boost its agility,
then charges at its prey.

records.name: Dondozo
records.description:
It treats Tatsugiri like its boss
and follows it loyally. Though
powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very
smart.

records.name: Tatsugiri
records.description:
This is a small dragon Pokémon. It
lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to
protect itself from enemies on the
outside.

records.name: Annihilape
records.description:
When its anger rose beyond a
critical point, this Pokémon gained power
that is unfettered by the limits of
its physical body.

records.name: Clodsire
records.description:
When attacked, this Pokémon will
retaliate by sticking thick spines out
from its body. It's a risky move
that puts everything on the line.

records.name: Farigiraf
records.description:
Now that the brain waves from the
head and tail are synced up, the
psychic power of this Pokémon is 10
times stronger than Girafarig's.

records.name: Dudunsprce
records.description:
This Pokémon uses its hard tail to
make its nest by boring holes into
bedrock deep underground. The nest
can reach lengths of over six miles.

prev.method: Level up knowing Hyper Drill (two-segment form)

records.name: Kingambit
records.description:
Though it commands a massive army
in battle, it's not skilled at
devising complex strategies. It just uses
brute strength to keep pushing.

records.name: Great Tusk
records.description:
Sightings of this Pokémon have
occurred in recent years. The name
Great Tusk was taken from a creature
listed in a certain book.

records.name: ScreamTail
records.description:
There has been only one reported
sighting of this Pokémon. It
resembles a mysterious creature depicted
in an old expedition journal.

records.name: BruteBonet
records.description:
It bears a slight resemblance to a
Pokémon described in a dubious
magazine as a cross between a dinosaur
and a mushroom.

records.name: FluttrMane
records.description:
It has similar features to a
ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a
paranormal magazine, but the two
have little else in common.

records.name: SlithrWing
records.description:
This mysterious Pokémon has some
similarities to a creature that an
old book introduced as Slither Wing.

records.name: SndyShocks
records.description:
It slightly resembles a Magneton
that lived for 10,000 years and was
featured in an article in a
paranormal magazine.

records.name: IronTreads
records.description:
Sightings of this Pokémon have
occurred in recent years. It resembles
a mysterious object described in an
old expedition journal.

records.name: IronBundle
records.description:
Its shape is similar to a robot
featured in a paranormal magazine
article. The robot was said to have been
created by an ancient civilization.

records.name: Iron Hands
records.description:
It is very similar to a cyborg
covered exclusively by a paranormal
magazine. The cyborg was said to be the
modified form of a certain athlete.

records.name: IronJuguls
records.description:
It resembles a certain Pokémon
introduced in a paranormal magazine,
described as the offspring of a
Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

records.name: Iron Moth
records.description:
No records exist of this species
being caught. Data is lacking, but
the Pokémon's traits match up with an
object described in an old book.

records.name: IronThorns
records.description:
It has some similarities to a
Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine
as a Tyranitar from one billion
years into the future.

records.name: Frigibax
records.description:
This Pokémon lives in forests and
craggy areas. Using the power of its
dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its
nest like a refrigerator.

records.name: Arctibax
records.description:
Arctibax freezes the air around it,
protecting its face with an ice
mask and turning its dorsal fin into a
blade of ice.

records.name: Baxcalibur
records.description:
It launches itself into battle by
flipping upside down and spewing
frigid air from its mouth. It finishes
opponents off with its dorsal blade.
