records.name: Gimmighoul
records.description:
It lives inside an old treasure
chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop
corners since no one realizes it's
actually a Pokémon.

records.name: Gholdengo
records.description:
It has a sturdy body made up of
stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms
its enemies by firing coin after coin
at them in quick succession.

records.name: Wo-Chien
records.description:
The grudge of a person punished
for writing the king's evil deeds upon
wooden tablets has clad itself in
dead leaves to become a Pokémon.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_9.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/wo_chien/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/wo_chien/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Chien-Pao
records.description:
This Pokémon can control 100 tons
of fallen snow. It plays around
innocently by leaping in and out of
avalanches it has caused.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_9.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/chien_pao/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/chien_pao/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Ting-Lu
records.description:
It slowly brings its exceedingly
heavy head down upon the ground,
splitting the earth open with huge
fissures that run over 160 feet deep.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_9.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/ting_lu/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/ting_lu/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Chi-Yu
records.description:
It controls flames burning at over
5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It
casually swims through the sea of lava it
creates by melting rock and sand.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: RoarngMoon
records.description:
According to an article in a
dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some
connection to Mega Evolution that
occurs in Hoenn.

records.name: IronVliant
records.description:
It has some similarities to a mad
scientist's invention covered in a
paranormal magazine.

records.name: Koraidon
records.description:
This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar,
but it is far burlier and more
ferocious. Nothing is known about its
ecology or other features.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_9.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/koraidon/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/koraidon/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Miraidon
records.description:
This seems to be the Iron Serpent
mentioned in an Violet Book. The
Iron Serpent is said to have turned the
land to ash with its lightning.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: WalkngWake
records.description: Ecology under research.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_9.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/walking_wake/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/walking_wake/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: IronLeaves
records.description: Ecology under analysis.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_9.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/iron_leaves/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/iron_leaves/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Dipplin
records.description:
Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon.
Its evolution was triggered by a special
apple grown only in one place.

records.name: Ptchageist
records.description:
Supposedly, the regrets of a tea
ceremony master who died before
perfecting his craft lingered in some
matcha and became a Pokémon.

records.name: Sinistcha
records.description:
It pretends to be tea, trying to fool
people into drinking it so it can
drain their life-force. Its ruse is
generally unsuccessful.

records.name: Okidogi
records.description:
After all its muscles were stimulated
by the toxic chain around its neck,
Okidogi transformed and gained
a powerful physique.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_9.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/okidogi/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/okidogi/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Munkidori
records.description:
The chain is made from toxins that
enhance capabilities. It stimulated
Munkidori's brain and caused the
Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Fezndipiti
records.description:
Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and
lovely voice to the toxic stimulants
emanating from the chain wrapped around
its body.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Ogerpon
records.description:
This Pokémon's type changes based on
which mask it's wearing. It confounds
its enemies with nimble movements
and kicks.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Archaludon
records.description:
It gathers static electricity
from its surroundings. The beams
it launches when down on all fours
are tremendously powerful.

records.name: Hydrapple
records.description:
These capricious syrpents have
banded together. On the rare
occasion that their moods align,
their true power is unleashed.

records.name: GouginFire
records.description:
There are scant few reports of
this creature being sighted.
One short video shows it rampaging,
and spouting pillars of flame.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_9.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/gouging_fire/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/gouging_fire/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: RagingBolt
records.description:
It bears resemblance to a Pokémon
that became a hot topic for a short
while after a paranomal magazine
touted it as Raikou's ancestor.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_9.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/raging_bolt/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/raging_bolt/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: IronBouldr
records.description:
It was named after a mysterious
object recorded in an old book.
Its body seems to be metallic.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_9.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/iron_boulder/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/iron_boulder/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Iron Crown
records.description:
It resembles a mysterious object
introduced in a paranormal magazine
as a cutting-edge weapon
shaped like Cobalion.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
records.source: src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_9.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue/pokemon/expansion/iron_crown/expansion_profile.json @origin/expansion; graphics/pokemon/iron_crown/front.png @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_pokedex.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_ridemon_infos.h @origin/expansion; src/data/rogue_routes.h @origin/expansion; src/data/party_menu.h @origin/expansion

records.name: Terapagos
records.description:
Terapagos protects itself using its
power to transform energy into hard
crystals. This Pokémon is the source
of the Terastal phenomenon.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter

records.name: Pecharunt
records.description:
It feeds others toxic mochi that
draw out desires and capabilities.
Those who eat the mochi fall under
Pecharunt's control, chained to its will.
notes: Spawns only as a legendary encounter
